name: @polymorph/jco-webrtc-datachannels
description: Browser-first (Node) host for polymorph:webrtc-datachannels, using jco + node-datachannel.

scripts.transpile: node check-flags.mjs && jco transpile ../examples/echo-demo/build/echo-demo.component.wasm --name echo-demo --async-mode jspi --async-exports 'demo:webrtc-echo/demo@0.1.0#run' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]data-channel.send' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]data-channel.receive' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]data-channel.send-via-stream' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]peer-connection.create-offer' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]peer-connection.create-answer' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]peer-connection.set-local-description' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]peer-connection.set-remote-description' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]peer-connection.add-ice-candidate' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]peer-connection.wait-connected' --map 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0=../webrtc.js' -o generated
scripts.transpile-remote: node check-flags.mjs && jco transpile ../examples/echo-remote/build/echo-remote.component.wasm --name echo-remote --async-mode jspi --async-exports 'demo:webrtc-echo/remote@0.1.0#run' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]data-channel.send' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]data-channel.receive' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]data-channel.send-via-stream' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]peer-connection.create-offer' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]peer-connection.create-answer' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]peer-connection.set-local-description' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]peer-connection.set-remote-description' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]peer-connection.add-ice-candidate' --async-imports 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0#[method]peer-connection.wait-connected' --async-imports 'demo:webrtc-echo/rendezvous@0.1.0#[static]session.open' --async-imports 'demo:webrtc-echo/rendezvous@0.1.0#[method]session.send' --async-imports 'demo:webrtc-echo/rendezvous@0.1.0#[method]session.recv' --async-imports 'demo:webrtc-echo/rendezvous@0.1.0#[method]session.done' --map 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0=../webrtc.js' --map 'demo:webrtc-echo/rendezvous@0.1.0=../rendezvous.js' -o generated-remote
